very_long_description.description: User reports a complex issue involving multiple systems. The problem started after the latest Windows update. The user cannot access the VPN, email is not syncing, printer shows offline, and Teams calls are dropping. We have tried multiple troubleshooting steps including: 1) Restarting the computer, 2) Checking network connectivity, 3) Verifying VPN credentials, 4) Re-adding email account, 5) Reinstalling printer drivers, 6) Clearing Teams cache. None of these steps have resolved the issue. The user is working from home and this is affecting their ability to work. They need urgent assistance as they have important client meetings scheduled. Additional context: The user's manager has confirmed this is business-critical. The user has been with the company for 5 years and this is the first time experiencing such widespread issues. System info: Windows 11 Pro, Version 22H2, 16GB RAM, Intel i7 processor.
